description: Job board posting with JobPosting JSON-LD (baseSalary min/max USD per YEAR, FULL_TIME, Austin TX address) and the same facts in visible text, plus a company rating, benefits with dollar amounts, a salary-guide widget and a 'Similar jobs' rail including a remote role at the same company.

salaryMin.description: Lower bound of the base salary range

salaryMax.description: Upper bound of the base salary range

salaryPeriod.description: Pay period of the salary range

location.description: City and state of the job, e.g. 'Denver, CO'

remote.description: True only when the role can be done fully remotely

notes: employmentType gold FULL_TIME is the enum form of the visible 'Full-time' (also verbatim in JSON-LD). salaryPeriod YEAR is shown as 'a year' / 'per year'. remote is false: 'On-site', 'In person', 'not eligible for fully remote work' (the 'Remote' similar jobs are decoys). Decoys: company rating 4.1 (212 reviews), salary guide $158,412, relocation $10,000, stipend $1,500, similar-job salaries, bonus 10%.
